paragraphs.text: Alandra is a merfolk storm shaper from the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar . She was invited to join the first official multiplanar class of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . This formal education prepares her to take over for her father Talrand , eventually. She aspires to become a member of the Prismari , the college of performance and passion.

Coldblooded Alandra is short and slim, with blue skin marked by fine white lines. Her teeth have serrated edges and deadly points. In place of hair, she has long layers of pink and purple fins that hang midway down her back. They bristle when she is nervous. Webbed toes and low-set fins on the backs of her legs make her prefer to go barefoot. Her fingers are also webbed. She has a flair for art and mischief. Her closest companion is Orestes , a young drake , who accompanies her everywhere and keeps her calm. Although she can come off as a bit shy and can struggle with anxiety, her temper is legendary, and she isn't afraid of confrontation — nor of unleashing the full fury of the storm on anyone who dares hurt her loved ones. Alandra is prone to anxiety attacks, a trait that was common for her species in the deep past.

Alandra was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina , because she had been identified as an ember ; a potential Planeswalker and powerful wizard. It is unknown if the Desparkening had any influence on her potential to ignite . This may yet come true under the right conditions. She knows that she can only return to Shandalar if she can show her father that she is strong enough to be his heir, wild enough to sculpt the storms, and clever enough to charm the drakes over to her side.
As stormsculpter, Alandra can create storms and torrential rain. She can also sculpt tiny storms and use them to fuse sand into word patterns.

Alandra 's father had bartered Orestes' egg for her as a hatchday gift. When he broke the shell, her face was the first he saw. Orestes is smart enough to know that she is not his mother, but that initial impression has left him with an ingrained need to please and care for her. He is always there to comfort her. In a few years, he'll be able to speak in her mind with words, the way the older drakes do. As it is unsafe for her on Shandalar as long as her father fights to hold the seas, Alandra isn't allowed to return.

On Arcavios, Alandra formed a class with Eula Blue , Segante , Jamira , and Kequia Akosa . While she shared a room with Eula, her side was designed as a water bubble where she could stay hydrated while sleeping. She used spell seeds that looked like pearls to create fresh clothes every day.

Despite her sleeping arrangements, Alandra suffered from the dryness of Arcavios. Used to the rich mana of Shandalar, she also constantly felt as if she couldn't breathe in the conditions of her new home. Meanwhile, in a secret plot, Professor Kasmina endeavored to create tensions between the classmates and emotionally isolate them. It was revealed that Kasmina had selected the five students because they had the potential to be powerful planeswalkers. Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own. This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl .

Afterward, Professor Vess had to task to to punish the five students for their various transgressions, with consideration of Kasmina's role. She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges, but forbade them to relocate to the appropriate dorms. This also allowed them to serve as residential advisors to the next incoming class of cross-planar students.

Alandra is a character that debuted in Jumpstart 2022 as part of the blue Think Again deck. No official lore was released about her at the time, so all that was known was based on her card and her similarities with others.
